explanations: checkCoupon reads `now` from the injected clock for the start check but calls Date.now() for the expiry check. Under a pinned clock the expiry check still uses the real time, so a coupon from 2020 is always "expired" and one expiring in 2098 never is. Every time-dependent decision has to go through the same injected clock; one stray Date.now() makes the function untestable and its tests date-dependent.
